obernants.approximation_semantics: Scoped relation, not a universal numerical certificate
obernants.assumptions: Successful allocations and each leaf's finite domain/error precedence. These are tagged relations, not automatic production adoption. Floating residuals are not solution-error guarantees. No generic 1/2/5/10% composition-wide profile; finite evidence remains separate from analytical claims.
obernants.domain: Leaf-admitted finite dense matrices, dimensions, tolerances and iteration budgets; symmetry/positivity are required only where each kernel declares them.
obernants.observation_scope: Tagged API values, states, errors and separately recorded finite joins
obernants.operator: In the tagged family relation, exclude outputs violating the selected leaf's invariant, domain/error precedence or coordinate convention. In particular: Dimensions, finite values, symmetry/rank conditions, sign/tie conventions and statuses remain leaf-specific. Permutation and basis coordinates must travel with results; a small residual does not by itself identify a unique eigenvector. Cross-family equality without the adapter assumptions in composition is excluded.
